(1) The present petition has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for the grant of regular bail in FIR No.63 dated 25.02.2020 registered under Sections 420, 120-B IPC and Section 13 of the Punjab Prevention of Humans Smuggling Act, 2012 at Police Station City Sri Muktsar Sahib, District Sri Muktsar Sahib.

sentences.text: 1 with the trial court Rs.2 lakhs for onward transmission to the complainant .
(4) Learned State counsel opposes the petition.
(5) Learned counsel for the parties have been heard and with their able assistance the record of the case has also been perused.

(6) The petitioner is a 47 year old lady with no other criminal antecedents; she is in custody since 29.12.2022; investigation in the case is complete; co-accused Baljinder Singh has been granted regular bail; co-accused Sukhvir Kaur and Ninderpal Kaur have been granted anticipatory bail and that the trial of the petitioner, as and when it begins, is likely to take a long time to conclude.
(7) In view of the above, the present case is considered to be a fit one in which the petitioner be directed to be released on regular bail.
Resultantly, subject to the satisfaction of the CJM/Duty Magistrate, Sri Muktsar Sahib, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail.

(8) In terms of the offer made by the petitioner, this order shall be subject to the petitioner's depositing Rs.2 lakhs before the trial court which shall be disbursed to the complainant against security and would abide by the final order to be passed in the petitioner's trial.

(9) It is clarified that the above observations have been made only for the limited purpose of deciding the present regular bail application and the same would not be construed to be an expression of opinion on the merits of the case.
